LanguageData.EL_Stim_MULE.label: M.U.L.E Stimulant Injector
LanguageData.EL_Stim_MULE.description:
An extreme muscle-stimulating stimulant, used before long marches to enhance the body's load-bearing capacity. It has proven effective in theaters with poor logistics, allowing soldiers to carry more weight for extended periods, as the name suggests.
[Applied Effects] carrying capacity ×200%, 0s delay/900s duration; deals 1 metabolic damage to random non-solid body parts every 10s, 0s delay/900s duration.

LanguageData.EL_Stim_Morphine.label: Morphine Injector
LanguageData.EL_Stim_Morphine.description:
A disposable pen-injector containing a large dose of morphine. After use, it drastically suppresses pain but increases metabolic consumption.
[Applied Effects] pain ×5%, 0s delay/305s duration; immediately consumes 15% food on use.

LanguageData.EL_Stim_Obdolbos.label: Obdolbos Cocktail Stimulant Injector
LanguageData.EL_Stim_Obdolbos.description:
An injector containing an unknown homemade drug, created by a former Terragroup medical expert. Each dose has different side effects. If you feel you have nothing left to lose, you might as well take the risk, at least the inventor of this stimulant did so himself.
[Applied Effects] randomly triggers 15 effects in total, each with an independent 25% chance, lasting 600s.

LanguageData.EL_Stim_xTG12_Antidote.label: xTG-12 Antidote Injector
LanguageData.EL_Stim_xTG12_Antidote.description:
A broad-spectrum antitoxin neutralizer, capable of neutralizing most artificial or natural toxins. When its components are distributed in the blood, it provides immunity to toxins. It has side effects on the body's self-repair function.
[Applied Effects] instantly removes toxic buildup, food poisoning, scaria infection, and lung rot, and grants immunity while active, 0s delay/240s duration; injury healing factor -10%, 180s delay/60s duration.

LanguageData.EL_Blueprint_Obdolbos.label: Obdolbos Recipe Notes
LanguageData.EL_Blueprint_Obdolbos.description: A notebook stored in a blueprint case, recording the complete formula for the Obdolbos cocktail stimulant injector. It is a manuscript copy left by a former Terragroup medical expert. Using it unlocks the Obdolbos crafting recipe at the drug lab.
LanguageData.EL_Blueprint_Obd2_cocktail.label: Obd2 Crafting Manual
LanguageData.EL_Blueprint_Obd2_cocktail.description: A technical manual stored in a blueprint case, recording the complete formula for the Obdolbos 2 cocktail stimulant injector. It is a printed publication based on the manuscript, seemingly more standardized. Using it unlocks the Obd2 crafting recipe at the drug lab.
